scripts/swarm_ledger/ledger_server.py:sc.reason: Only lowercases the Cache-Control field name in send_export. HTTP field names are case-insensitive (RFC 9110 section 5.1), so the export response still carries Cache-Control no-store with the same Content-Type, Content-Length and body bytes. Handler.send_header only branches on keyword.lower() equal to content-type, which cache-control never matches, so no header is added or dropped. No ledger server, page or test code reads the raw case of the export response header names.
